messages:
Ravi: Quick proposal: extract the structured-output section into two focused pages to make migration notes clearer and reduce PR size. Page A: JSON Schema + validation samples. Page B: runtime parsing patterns + SDK snippets + fallback heuristics.

Ana: I can take Page A. Will add AJV validation snippet and two compact examples (nullable arrays, union wrap).

Liam: I'll own Page B. Plan to add a minimal SDK 4.x parse-envelopes snippet, a regex fallback example, and short guidance on when to prefer function-calling.

Marta: I'll do a link sweep and prepare a small redirects map; will open a links-only PR to avoid blocking merges.

DocsBot: Reminder: add 'migration-notes' label for any example that changes call shapes; run link-checker before merge.

Ravi: Timeline: drafts tomorrow, land both by Friday. Keep snippets tiny and copy-paste safe for users.

Ana: Draft PRs up: A = https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/995 (schemas + examples). Left a TODO to run the linter.

Liam: Draft PR B = https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/996 (parsing + SDK). Pushed a short parse fallback snippet: ```js
try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { const m = /"result"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/.exec(text); return m ? {result: m[1]} : {raw: text, parseError: true}; }
```

Marta: Links PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/997 with redirects for moved example paths and sidebar updates.

Ravi: Great. I'll review both tomorrow morning. Please add one-line migration blurb comparing SDK 3.x -> 4.x function call payloads in PR descriptions.

Ana: merged PR 995 after lint patch.

Liam: PR 996 merged after addressing a docs-style nit. Added the SDK migration blurb.

Marta: merged redirects PR 997 and updated release-notes draft.

Ravi: Added a one-line release note: "Docs: separated schema and parsing guidance; added SDK 4.x parsing fallback examples and redirect map." Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
